title.narrative: Andhra Pradesh Health Systems Strengthening Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objectives are to improve the quality and responsiveness of public health services and increase access of the population to an expanded package of primary health services.

The development objectives of Andhra Pradesh Health Systems Strengthening Project for India are to improve the quality and responsiveness of public health services and increase access of the population to an expanded package of primary health services. This project has three components. 1) The first component, Improve Quality of Care, aims to focus on improving the quality of care in Community Health Centers (CHCs) and Primary Health Centers (PHCs), which are often the first point of contact in the health system. 2) The second component, Improve Responsiveness of Public Health Services, aims to will complement Component 1 by focusing on making public health services more user-friendly and responsive to peoples feedback, which is a key element of quality. 3) The third component, Increase Access to an Expanded Package of Primary Health Services, aims to focus on expanding the package of services provided at PHCs and Subcenters (SCs) to include Noncommunicable Disease (NCD) screening, risk-stratification and management in addition to strengthening the existing Maternal and Child Health (MCH) services.

condition.narrative: Project Agreement, Schedule, Section I, Part A, Para 1: the Project Implementing Entity maintain throughout the period ofimplementation of the Project, a Project Coordination Cell (PCC) under the National Health Mission (NHM) in DoHFW, headed by astate mission director, NHM, to be responsible for the day-to-day management and coordination of the Project.

Project Agreement, Schedule, Section I, Part A, Para 2: the Project Implementing Entity shall appoint, not later than one monthafter the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain throughout Project implementation, an independent DLI verification agent havingqualifications and terms of reference acceptable to the Bank to verify the achievement of selected DLRs as provided in Schedule 3to the Loan Agreement.

title.narrative: Research and evaluation undertaken to support the innovative approaches to delivery of primary health care

baseline.value: Population-based survey of NCD risk factor prevalence not undertaken and e-subcenter model overall effectiveness not evaluated

target.value: End-line study for evaluation on e-subcenter completed

comment.narrative: Partially met. NCD surveys and evaluation of MMU visits to VHCs and communities fully meets the intention of this IRI, but a planned evaluation of HWCs was not done before the project ended.

actual.value: NCD surveys completed. Evaluations of pilots for all innovative approaches done before full roll-out. New system of Mobile Medical team regular bi-weekly visits to VHCs evaluated and costed.
